artifacts.title: Artifact Upload & OCR
artifacts.description: The artifact system lets users attach physical documents (CNIC scans, salary slips, medical reports, X-rays, policy forms) to a case and automatically extract their contents via the OCR Engine (the platform's configured multimodal LLM, Gemini 2.5 Flash by default). Results are stored in the artifacts table and can be retrieved with a fresh presigned download URL at any time.

cases.title: Case Management
cases.description: The case management module provides a full lifecycle for tracking insurance work items — underwriting proposals, claim investigations, and general inquiries. Every case has an audit trail, workflow state, assignment history, comments, and file attachments.

chat-agent.title: AI Copilot (Chat Agent)
chat-agent.description: The copilot is a conversational agent embedded in the web portal (and the agent app's Chat screen) that can look things up, onboard leads, run the underwriting and claims pipelines, and navigate the UI — while every mutating action is gated in code, not just in the prompt.

client-apps.title: Client Apps
client-apps.description: Both clients talk only to the API Gateway (:8010) — except the web portal's OCR and summarizer screens, which call those services directly via NEXTPUBLICOCRURL / NEXTPUBLICSUMMARIZERURL.

commission-earnings.title: Commission Earnings
commission-earnings.description: The portal at /commissions now reads persisted accrued gross earnings from the tenant service. The mobile commission screen and copilot ledger, summary, payee and statement tools use that same backend. A policy's status never implies a commission payment.

contributing.title: Contributing
contributing.description: Full team guide: Git Branch and Commit Naming Convention (ClickUp).

data-flow.title: Data Flow
data-flow.description: Requirements/evidence gate (runs before either evaluate path below)

fraud-layer.title: Fraud Detection Layer
fraud-layer.description: The fraud detection layer is a purpose-built graph intelligence system that sits inside the Risk Engine. It combines a Memgraph graph database (relationship detection) with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (probabilistic scoring) to catch coordinated fraud rings that purely statistical models miss.

intro.title: Overview
intro.description: insurance-ai is an AI-powered, multi-tenant life-insurance platform built for Pakistani insurers. It covers the full policy journey — lead intake, quotation, pre-underwriting clearance, AI underwriting, issuance, in-force servicing, and claims — on a FastAPI microservice backend with LLMs, a Memgraph fraud graph, and a Kafka event bus.

policy-lifecycle.description: This page walks a policy from lead to claim and names the router that owns each step. All routes are under /tenants/ and reach the Tenant Service through the API Gateway.
